name: hydration-break
title: Hydration Break
description: Mimics FIFA World Cup hydration breaks in your menu bar and reminds you to drink water — with optional live-match sync.
author: mihaeltomic

commands.name: hydration-break
commands.title: Hydration Break
commands.description: Spreads your daily water goal across FIFA-style hydration breaks in your menu bar and reminds you to drink.

commands.name: hydrate
commands.title: Hydrate
commands.description: Logs a glass of water instantly. Bind it to a hotkey for one-tap hydration.
commands.subtitle: Hydration Break

commands.name: follow-match
commands.title: Follow Live Match
commands.subtitle: Pick a World Cup match
commands.description: Pick a real World Cup match. Hydration breaks then fire at that match's real 22' and 67' marks instead of your daily schedule.

preferences.name: hydrationGoal
preferences.title: Daily Goal
preferences.description: Glasses of water per day. Your active hours are split into this many evenly-spaced hydration breaks.

preferences.name: dayStart
preferences.title: Active Hours
preferences.description: When your hydration day starts (24h, HH:MM). The first break comes shortly after this.

preferences.name: dayEnd
preferences.title: Active Hours End
preferences.description: When your hydration day ends (24h, HH:MM). The last break comes shortly before this.

preferences.name: breakDuration
preferences.title: Break Duration
preferences.description: How many minutes each hydration break window lasts.

preferences.name: alertOnBreak
preferences.title: Break Alert
preferences.description: Show a system notification and blow the referee whistle when a hydration break starts.
preferences.label: Notify me when a hydration break starts

preferences.name: playCheer
preferences.title: Crowd Cheer
preferences.description: Play a football crowd cheer each time you log a glass of water.
preferences.label: Play a crowd cheer when you drink water

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
